name: Zozonest
author: zozothemes

sections.description:
Zozonest is a powerful real estate plugin that allows you to create property listings, agent profiles, location-based search, Google Maps integration, and interactive property showcases using Elementor.

This real estate plugin helps you build property grids, agent lists, map views, search filters, and modern property presentations directly inside the Elementor page builder.

Create beautiful property listings, agent profiles, map views, virtual tours, and advanced search options — all inside Elementor.

The plugin is built with performance, flexibility, and design freedom in mind. Perfect for real estate agencies, property managers, agents, and developers.

Live Demo
Documentation

Why Choose Zozonest?

✔ Custom property and agent post types
✔ Hierarchical location taxonomies (country, state, city, area)
✔ Advanced property search and filtering
✔ Google Maps integration for property maps and admin location pickers
✔ Front-end agent dashboards (profile, properties, favorites, inbox)
✔ Front-end property submission and editing
✔ Property favorites
✔ Printable property views
✔ Virtual tour, 360° panorama, video, and floor plans
✔ Mortgage calculator widget
✔ Login, registration, and forgot password shortcodes
✔ Elementor widgets for listings, search, maps, taxonomy lists, and agents
✔ JSON import/export for plugin settings
✔ Demo import for properties, agents, and pages
✔ Fully responsive and RTL ready

Zozonest is designed as a lightweight real estate plugin focusing purely on property listings and agent profiles without adding unnecessary features.

Perfect Alternative To Heavy Real Estate Plugins

Zozonest provides a lightweight alternative to large real estate addon plugins. Instead of installing huge real estate packages, this plugin focuses specifically on property listings, agent profiles, and Google Maps integration while maintaining excellent performance.

Property Layouts

Create visually engaging property layouts with full Elementor customization.

  • Property Grid
    Display properties in structured responsive grid layouts with flexible columns and spacing.

  • Property List & List Slider
    Display properties in storytelling layouts ideal for property highlights. Supports 2, 3, and 4 column layouts and slider format.

  • Property Masonry
    Create modern masonry layouts that dynamically adjust item height for visually appealing property galleries. Supports filtering, gutters, and fullwidth layouts.

Advanced Features

Bring motion and interaction to your property presentations.

  • Map Views
    Showcase properties on Google Maps with customizable markers, map styles, and filtering options. Ideal for helping users find properties by location.

  • Property Pagination & AJAX Load More
    Control how users browse properties with classic pagination or AJAX load more. Content loads dynamically without page refresh, improving user experience.

  • Property Gallery Variations
    Create visually rich property image galleries with flexible layout options designed for speed and responsiveness. Each gallery adapts seamlessly to different screen sizes while maintaining sharp visuals and smooth interactions.

  • Virtual Tour & 360° Panorama
    Add immersive virtual tours and 360° image views to properties to give users a better feel for the space.

  • Property Hover & Interaction Styles
    Enhance user engagement with modern hover effects that reveal property details without cluttering the layout. Designed to feel smooth, lightweight, and visually appealing.

RTL Support

Zozonest is fully optimized for Right-to-Left languages.

Key Features at a Glance

✔ Custom Post Types for Properties & Agents
✔ Property Categories, Actions, and Location Taxonomies
✔ Elementor Widgets (Grid, List, Slider, Masonry, Filter, Search, Map, Agent)
✔ Google Maps Integration
✔ Property Favorites
✔ Printable Property Views
✔ Virtual Tour & 360° Panorama
✔ Mortgage Calculator Widget
✔ Front-end Property Submission
✔ Agent Dashboards
✔ Demo Import
✔ Responsive Design
✔ RTL Ready
✔ Theme Independent

Perfect For

✔ Real estate agencies
✔ Property managers
✔ Real estate agents
✔ Photographers
✔ Developers building real estate websites
✔ Freelancers showcasing properties

More details

Support

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the zozonest folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Open Zozonest > Property Options to configure currency, units, map options, and property features
  4. Create WordPress pages and assign the included page templates (User Profile, Add New Property, Search Result, and others)
  5. Add your Google Maps API key under map settings if you use maps
  6. Create properties and agents from the WordPress admin or allow agents to submit from the front end
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Elementor is recommended for the included widgets, but the plugin also provides shortcodes, classic widgets, and template files that work without Elementor.

Can I customize templates?

Yes. Templates can be overridden using:
your-theme/zozonest/

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, it works with all modern WordPress themes.

Does the plugin support Google Maps?

Yes. Google Maps integration is included for property maps, admin location pickers, and search widgets.
